title: Discovery of novel covalent stabilizers for p53 Y220C using structure-based drug discovery methods.
authors: Wen, Yiming; Xu, Peijia; Chen, Yijie; Meng, Jingyi; Zheng, Mingyue; Zhang, Sulin; Teng, Dan; Li, Xutong
one_liner_zh: 该文通过虚拟筛选和分子动力学模拟发现p53 Y220C共价稳定剂，虽涉及p53-DNA结合功能恢复，但核心是药物分子与蛋白的共价结合，而非TF-DNA互作建模，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: The p53 Y220C mutation, a prevalent structural variant in human cancers, compromises DNA binding and tumor suppressor functions by destabilizing the protein structure. Leveraging a combined approach of structure-based virtual screening, molecular dynamics simulations, and in vitro assays, we have identified C8, a racemic compound with an indole core and alpha, beta-unsaturated carbonyl groups, as a covalent stabilizer for p53 Y220C. Protein thermal shift and homogeneous time-resolved fluorescence assays confirmed that C8 and its analogs selectively bind to p53 Y220C and restore its DNA binding ability. Subsequent molecular dynamics simulations and structure-activity relationship analyses showed that both enantiomers of C8 form covalent bonds with Cys124 and Cys220, stabilizing the mutant structure. C8 and its analogs emerge as promising lead candidates for restoring the Y220C mutant's transcriptional function, highlights the potential of this scaffold for further optimization into p53 Y220C-targeted therapeutics.
abstract_zh: p53 Y220C突变是人类癌症中一种常见的结构变异，通过破坏蛋白质结构的稳定性，削弱了DNA结合和肿瘤抑制功能。结合基于结构的虚拟筛选、分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟和体外实验的综合方法，我们鉴定出C8——一种含有吲哚核心和α,β-不饱和羰基的外消旋化合物——作为p53 Y220C的共价稳定剂。蛋白质热位移和均相时间分辨荧光实验证实，C8及其类似物选择性结合p53 Y220C并恢复其DNA结合能力。随后的分子动力学模拟和构效关系分析表明，C8的两种对映体均与Cys124和Cys220形成共价键，从而稳定突变体结构。C8及其类似物作为恢复Y220C突变体转录功能的有前景的先导候选物，凸显了该骨架在进一步优化为靶向p53 Y220C治疗药物方面的潜力。
